gloss: to be doable; to be okay; to work

definitions.gloss: to be doable; to be possible; to work out
definitions.explanation: Colloquial expression indicating something is feasible or acceptable.

definitions.gloss: to be good; to be tasty; to be not bad
definitions.explanation: Used to express that something (food, drink) is surprisingly good or acceptable.

examples.japanese: 「{明日|あした}、{来|こ}れる？」「うん、いけると{思|おも}う。」
examples.english: "Can you come tomorrow?" "Yeah, I think I can make it."

examples.japanese: この{料理|りょうり}、{結構|けっこう}いけるね。
examples.english: This dish is pretty good, isn't it?

examples.japanese: もうちょっとでいけそうだ。
examples.english: I think we can almost make it.

notes:
ORIGIN:
Derived from {行|い}ける (potential form of {行|い}く), extended to mean "things can go/work."

USAGE PATTERNS:
・いける？ / いけます？ - Can you do it? / Does it work?
・いけると{思|おも}う - I think it'll work
・いけそう - looks doable
・{結構|けっこう}いける - pretty good (unexpectedly)

REGISTER:
Casual/colloquial. Common in everyday conversation.

SIMILAR:
・{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ} - okay, all right
・できる - can do
・{行|い}ける - can go (literal meaning)
